ideas.pitch: A command-line tool for competitive programmers to local-test code against custom test cases and benchmark execution time instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: Timed competitive programming challenge by solving a set of algorithmic problems of increasing difficulty using C, C++, Java, and Python.
ideas.title: CP-Helper CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on speed and developer ergonomics during high-pressure timed contests where shaving seconds off testing saves leaderboard penalties.

ideas.pitch: An interactive tool to visualize graph traversals, sorting steps, and dynamic programming state transitions for practice.
ideas.problem_statement: Problems will cover arrays, strings, sorting, greedy algorithms, graphs, and dynamic programming.
ideas.title: Algorithmic Complexity Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a genuinely hard engineering problem of stepping backward through state spaces for DP and graph algorithms, helping contestants debug logic.

ideas.pitch: A linter and visual debugger specifically designed to catch off-by-one errors and base case flaws in dynamic programming memoization tables.
ideas.problem_statement: Problems will cover arrays, strings, sorting, greedy algorithms, graphs, and dynamic programming.
ideas.title: DP State Transition Debugger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the exact problem category that causes the most incorrect submission penalties in competitive programming contests.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight local dashboard that simulates ICPC-style penalty calculations and predicts rank shifts during a timed contest.
ideas.problem_statement: Rankings will be determined by the number of problems solved, followed by total time, including penalties for incorrect submissions.
ideas.title: Contest Leaderboard Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a working live demo that directly maps to the exact scoring criteria of the hackathon's judging platform.

ideas.pitch: An instant scratchpad for building, testing, and verifying network flow, shortest path, and MST algorithms against custom edge cases.
ideas.problem_statement: Problems will cover arrays, strings, sorting, greedy algorithms, graphs, and dynamic programming.
ideas.title: Graph Algorithm Playground
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a rock-solid, working demo for graph problems that typically stump contestants under time pressure.
